name: mattermost
description: Mattermost offers modern team communication, behind your firewall. Share messages and files across phones and PCs, with archiving and instant search.

events.d: Get a single message by its ID.
Delete a message by its ID.
Post a message to a channel or as a direct message, with optional thread reply, files and priority.
Edit the text, pin state, files or props of an existing message.
Add one or more users to a channel.
Create a public or private channel in a team; choose team, handle, display name, type, and optional header or purpose.
Search messages in a team by keywords, with from: and in: filters.
Find a user by email, username, or ID.
Add an emoji reaction to a message as the connected user.
Runs when a new message is posted in a chosen channel, optionally including thread replies.
